name: nature-ppt
description: Reconstruct reference images as all-native editable PowerPoint content with direct or budgeted vectorization.

interface.shortDescription: Reference images to practical editable PowerPoint.
interface.longDescription: Nature PPT preflights image complexity, traces simple artwork directly, compresses complex artwork to a bounded native object set, restores live text, and never hides a raster background beneath editable overlays.
defaultPrompt: Reconstruct this reference as a practical editable PowerPoint.
Convert this scientific figure to native PowerPoint objects.
Preflight this image and choose direct or light-native reconstruction.
